csv_scope_of_work: The City of Los Altos ( City ) is requesting proposals from qualified planning, architecture, or urban design firms to update and refine the City s Objective Design Standards. This effort is intended to ensure the standards reflect current development patterns and community context; provide clear, measurable, and user-friendly criteria that can be applied consistently across project types; reduce ambiguity and processing time for applicants and staff; and align the City s design expectations with applicable state housing and permitting laws that emphasize objective standards and streamlined review.
